title: Sổ Đỏ Đứng Tên Ai
location: Sảnh tiệc khách sạn sang trọng nơi đang diễn ra lễ ăn hỏi của Tùng và Vy, buổi tối; clip cuối ở góc khuất sau cổng hoa trên sân khấu.
axis: Máy quay đặt giữa lối đi nhìn lên sân khấu: cổng hoa và phông tim vàng ở giữa, bàn dài bày khay sính lễ ngay dưới sân khấu, bàn tròn đầu tiên bên trái, cửa lớn sau lưng máy; góc khuất sau cổng hoa dẫn ra cửa phụ phía sau sân khấu.
props: Sổ đỏ màu hồng đỏ không chữ đọc được, đơn ly hôn không chữ và bút ký, hộp quà đỏ đã mở, khay sính lễ phủ vải đỏ, cặp tài liệu da đen của Khải, gậy tre của bà Nhàn, thước dây vàng trên cổ Thu.
setting: A lavish hotel banquet hall set for an engagement ceremony in the evening: round tables with white cloths and red roses, a low stage with a flower arch and a gold heart backdrop with no letters, trays of betrothal gifts covered in red cloth, crystal chandeliers, warm golden light.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Ảnh cũ thì sao nào? Chị vẫn phải ký ly hôn, căn nhà kia vẫn là sính lễ của em!

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Sổ đỏ căn nhà ấy đây em. Đứng tên chị, từ mười hai năm trước rồi.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Anh Tùng! Anh hứa cho em cái nhà của vợ anh à? Anh lừa cả em đấy à?

shots.camera: 28mm wide shot of the bride standing at the long betrothal table below the stage, facing the camera, slow push-in
50mm medium shot of the bride at the betrothal table, slow push-in
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the bride onto the tailor across the table, locked off
85mm close-up of the bride whirling toward the hall, locked off

steps: @Vy stands at the long betrothal table below the stage in her red wedding áo dài, chin raised, and is already speaking fast and venomous across the table.
@Vy keeps talking fast, flicking one hand toward the covered trays of betrothal gifts.
@Vy keeps speaking, leaning over the red cloth, eyes narrowed, her gold necklace catching the light.
@Vy goes on without a pause, tapping one red fingernail on the tablecloth.
@Vy finishes the last words with her chin high and closes her mouth, one hand still raised.
@Thu, across the table in her green apron, draws a pink-red land title booklet with no readable writing from her apron pocket and starts answering slowly and coldly.
@Thu lays the booklet flat on the red cloth and keeps speaking in a quiet ice-cold voice.
@Thu keeps talking evenly, two fingers resting on the booklet, eyes steady on @Vy.
@Thu goes on without raising her voice, while @Vy's raised hand sinks, mouth closed.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, two fingers still on the booklet, while @Vy stares down at it with her mouth closed.
@Vy whirls toward someone beyond the frame and snaps a furious question, jaw tight.
@Vy keeps speaking fast at the unseen groom, one finger pointing back at the booklet.
@Vy keeps talking, her voice climbing, her red khăn vấn headband trembling.
@Vy says her last words and closes her mouth, breathing hard through her nose.
@Vy stands rigid with her mouth closed and her jaw tight, the gold phoenix on her silk rising and falling with each breath.
clips.sfx: a murmur rippling through unseen guests, silk rustling, the soft tap of a booklet laid on cloth, a chandelier crystal tinkling

wardrobe.@Vy: a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, a matching red khăn vấn headband, a thin gold necklace, beige high heels

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Không thể nào! Nhà con bỏ tiền ra xây, công ty con một tay gây dựng cơ mà!

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Bằng tiền mảnh đất bố cái Thu để lại đấy. Giấy con ký, con quên, chứ mẹ chưa quên.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Sao hồi ấy mẹ không nhắc con lấy một câu hả mẹ?

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot of mother and son beside the first round table below the stage, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the old mother leaning on her walking stick, locked off
40mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the old mother onto her son, locked off
28mm wide shot of mother and son by the first round table under the chandeliers, locked off

steps: @Tung turns from the stage toward @BaNhan, palms spread wide, his face flushed, and is already speaking fast, while @BaNhan leans on her carved bamboo walking stick with her mouth closed.
@Tung keeps talking fast, tapping his own chest with his fingertips.
@Tung keeps speaking, his voice rising, his spread hands trembling in the air.
@Tung goes on, waving one hand toward the stage and the gold heart backdrop.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @BaNhan lifts her chin and starts answering slowly and sternly.
@BaNhan keeps speaking slowly, her wrinkled face perfectly still, eyes fixed on her son.
@BaNhan goes on in a heavy stern voice, both thin hands folded over the head of her bamboo stick.
@BaNhan keeps speaking without blinking, one eyebrow lifting slightly.
@BaNhan keeps talking, tapping one finger on the head of the stick.
@BaNhan says the last words slowly, her lips thin.
@BaNhan closes her mouth, and @Tung, his spread hands dropping, starts asking a childish question.
@Tung keeps talking fast, his voice cracking, his eyes darting to his mother's face.
@Tung keeps speaking, swaying half a step back.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, his shoulders sagging.
@BaNhan taps the tip of her stick once on the carpet, both silent, while @Tung lowers his eyes with his mouth closed.
clips.sfx: a sharp hush falling over unseen guests, wine glasses chiming softly, the tap of a bamboo stick on carpet

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Đơn ly hôn em ký rồi. Nhà, với sáu mươi phần trăm cổ phần, là của em.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thu ơi, anh xin em. Anh mất hết rồi, anh còn gì nữa đâu.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Còn chứ. Anh còn nợ con một bữa cơm, con bé vẫn để phần bát cho bố.

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the tailor bending over the signing table, slow tilt up
85mm close-up of the husband sinking onto a banquet chair, locked off
40mm medium two-shot across the table, the tailor standing over the seated husband, locked off
85mm close-up of the tailor, locked off

steps: @Thu bends over the white tablecloth with an uncapped black pen, divorce papers with no readable writing in front of her, and is already speaking in a level businesslike voice.
@Thu keeps talking evenly as she signs the papers in one unhurried stroke.
@Thu keeps speaking, turning the page and signing again without looking up.
@Thu straightens up and goes on calmly, squaring the stack beside the pink-red land title booklet.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, sliding the signed papers across the table toward @Tung.
@Tung sinks heavily onto a banquet chair and starts answering in a broken whisper, his face drained.
@Tung keeps whispering, his hands open on his knees, eyes glistening.
@Tung keeps talking, his voice cracking, staring up at her.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, lips trembling.
@Thu caps the pen and answers slowly and quietly, looking down at @Tung.
@Thu keeps speaking calmly, not unkind, her hands resting on the signed papers.
@Thu keeps talking, her voice softening a little.
@Thu keeps speaking slowly, her eyes steady and calm.
@Thu says the last words and closes her mouth.
@Thu smooths the yellow tailor's measuring tape around her neck in silence, mouth closed, her eyes on the papers.
clips.sfx: a pen scratching across paper, a banquet chair creaking under sudden weight, a hushed hall, one long shaky breath

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Tiền vẫn nằm yên trong tài khoản. Đi ngay, kẻo bà vợ cả lại lôi thêm cái gì ra nữa!

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Lối thoát hiểm sau bếp, anh đi trước đi. Xe em đỗ sẵn ở cửa sau rồi.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Hai vé bay sáng ngày kia trong túi em, đổi ngay sang chuyến đêm nay.

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the man in black slipping behind the flower arch, handheld
85mm close-up of the bride in the shadows, golden light flickering on her face
40mm medium two-shot of the couple edging along the back of the backdrop, slow lateral track
28mm wide shot of the dark wings behind the stage as the couple reaches the side door, locked off

steps: @Khai slips behind the flower arch with the black leather document folder under his arm, glances back and is already speaking fast in a low hiss.
@Khai keeps hissing urgently, tapping the folder with two fingers.
@Khai keeps talking quickly over his shoulder, eyes darting to the gaps in the roses.
@Khai goes on in a rapid whisper, golden light from the hall flickering through the roses onto his face.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, beckoning someone in after him.
@Vy hurries in, gathers the long front flap of her red wedding áo dài in one hand and answers in a breathless whisper.
@Vy keeps whispering fast, pointing toward a dark side door beyond the coils of cable.
@Vy keeps whispering, her eyes on the glowing gaps in the arch, her red khăn vấn headband askew.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, catching her breath.
@Khai nods and replies low and quick, already moving along the back of the backdrop.
@Khai keeps speaking low and decisive, while @Vy follows close behind with her mouth closed.
@Khai keeps talking under his breath, the folder pressed to his chest.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, one hand reaching for the handle of the dark side door.
Both stand silent at the side door, golden light flickering over their faces as the murmur of the hall swells behind the backdrop.
@Khai eases the side door open onto darkness, and @Vy follows him through in tiny steps, both silent.
clips.sfx: the muffled murmur of the banquet hall beyond the backdrop, rustling silk, quick hushed footsteps on wooden boards, a cable rattling

wardrobe.@Vy: a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, a matching red khăn vấn headband, a thin gold necklace, beige high heels

title: Lối Thoát Hiểm
time_label: Tối, hành lang sau sảnh tiệc (18:00–19:00)
location: Hành lang phục vụ hẹp phía sau sảnh tiệc khách sạn, buổi tối; cuối hành lang là cửa kính mờ thoát hiểm.
axis: Máy quay đặt dọc hành lang hẹp: đầu hành lang phía sảnh tiệc có cửa bếp lật, đầu kia là cửa kính mờ thoát hiểm nhấp nháy ánh xanh đỏ; chồng ghế tiệc và xe đẩy khăn trải bàn xếp dọc tường bê tông.
props: Áo dài cưới đỏ thêu phượng vàng may khít và khăn vấn đỏ của Vy, giày cao gót màu be, cặp tài liệu da đen của Khải, chồng ghế tiệc, xe đẩy khăn trải bàn, cửa kính mờ nhấp nháy ánh xanh đỏ, thước dây vàng trên cổ Thu.
setting: A narrow hotel service corridor behind the banquet hall at night: bare concrete walls, stacked banquet chairs and linen carts, humming fluorescent light, a frosted glass exit door at the far end pulsing with blue and red light from outside.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Anh đợi em với! Áo bó quá, đầu gối em dính chặt vào nhau, chỉ nhích được từng tí một!

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Áo vợ thằng Tùng may mà em cũng dám mặc à? Nhấc chân lên, nhanh lên nào!

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Đẹp thì em mặc! Ai biết hôm nay lại phải chạy thục mạng thế này!

shots.camera: 50mm medium tracking shot backward in front of the bride as she shuffles along the corridor
85mm close-up of the man in black spinning round, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the man in black onto the bride, locked off
40mm medium two-shot tracking backward in front of the couple down the corridor

steps: @Vy shuffles along the empty service corridor in tiny hobbled steps, the tight red wedding áo dài holding her knees together, and is already speaking fast and breathless.
@Vy keeps whining as she totters forward, one hand on the bare concrete wall, her beige high heels clacking.
@Vy keeps talking breathlessly, glaring ahead down the corridor.
@Vy goes on, panting, her knees held together by the tight silk.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, gasping for air.
@Khai, striding ahead, spins round, waving the black leather document folder, and answers in a sharp exasperated hiss.
@Khai keeps hissing, pointing the folder at her tight red silk.
@Khai keeps talking fast, his thin moustache twitching, eyes flicking to the far door.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, beckoning hard with the folder.
@Vy pouts and starts answering back in a sulky voice, still shuffling toward him in tiny steps.
@Vy keeps talking sulkily, smoothing the gold phoenix on her silk with one hand.
@Vy keeps speaking, lips pouting, while @Khai listens with his mouth closed.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth as @Khai turns back toward the far door.
@Vy shuffles faster in tiny steps after @Khai, both silent, the frosted exit door glowing ahead of them.
@Vy's flushed face and smudged red lipstick lead the frame as she hurries on behind @Khai, both silent, mouths closed.
clips.sfx: fluorescent hum, high heels clacking fast on concrete, rustling silk, a linen cart rattling as they pass

wardrobe.@Vy: a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, a matching red khăn vấn headband, a thin gold necklace, beige high heels

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Anh đứng ngây ra đấy làm gì? Mở cửa ra đi, xe mình ở ngay ngoài kia rồi!

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Em nhìn qua kính mà xem. Đèn xanh, đèn đỏ. Xe ngoài kia không phải xe mình đâu.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Bà thợ may ấy đo cả đường chạy của mình rồi, anh ơi.

shots.camera: 40mm medium two-shot tracking backward in front of the couple down the corridor, holding the previous framing
85mm close-up of the man in black, blue and red light sweeping his face, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the man in black onto the bride, slow push-in
100mm extreme close-up of the bride's face, blue and red light sweeping across it, locked off

steps: @Vy hurries the last steps toward the frosted glass exit door behind @Khai and is already speaking in a frantic hiss, flapping a hand at the door.
@Vy keeps whispering fast, while @Khai pulls up short before the glass with his mouth closed.
@Vy keeps talking, pointing past him at the door, her face washed red then blue by the light through the glass.
@Vy goes on urgently, tugging at the tight red silk at her knees.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, and @Khai, his eyes on the pulsing glass, starts answering in a flat hollow voice.
@Khai keeps speaking flatly, nodding at the frosted glass.
@Khai keeps talking, the blue and red light sweeping across his face, the folder hanging limp at his side.
@Khai goes on in the same hollow voice, his shoulders dropping.
@Khai keeps speaking quietly to the end, staring at the glass.
@Khai closes his mouth, and @Vy turns her head to look back down the long corridor and starts murmuring slowly in a shaky whisper.
@Vy keeps whispering, her fingers twisting the red silk at her hip.
@Vy keeps murmuring, her eyes wide.
@Vy keeps whispering, the light flashing red then blue across her cheek.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, her lips trembling.
@Vy stands motionless with her mouth closed, blue and red light sweeping across her face and the red khăn vấn headband.
clips.sfx: a siren whooping once outside, fluorescent hum, fast shallow breathing, silk rustling

wardrobe.@Vy: a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, a matching red khăn vấn headband, a thin gold necklace, beige high heels

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Em đi đâu mà vội thế? Tiệc còn chưa xong, hai họ vẫn đang chờ kia mà.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chị cố tình may chật để em không chạy được! Chị tính cả rồi chứ gì!

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Áo dài thì phải khít. Mặc nó để bước cho đàng hoàng, đâu phải để chạy.

85mm close-up of the bride whirling round, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the bride onto the tailor, locked off
40mm medium two-shot in profile down the corridor, slow drift

steps: @Thu steps through the swinging kitchen door in her green apron, stops several paces away with her hands folded and is already speaking in a dry, almost polite voice.
@Thu keeps talking evenly, tilting her head toward the noise of the banquet hall behind her.
@Thu keeps speaking, the kitchen door still swinging on its hinge behind her.
@Thu goes on calmly, her eyes resting on the tight red silk.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, hands still folded on her green apron.
@Vy whirls round and answers fast in a cracked, furious voice, tears smearing her winged eyeliner.
@Vy keeps sobbing out the words, her chin trembling and her chest heaving.
@Vy keeps talking fast, pointing down at her own hobbled knees.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, breathing hard.
@Thu answers slowly and evenly from where she stands, keeping her distance.
@Thu keeps speaking calmly, one hand lifting toward the hem without coming any closer.
@Thu keeps talking, her voice never rising, the blue and red light pulsing on the wall behind @Vy.
@Thu keeps speaking evenly, while @Vy listens with her mouth closed and her chest heaving.
@Thu finishes, closes her mouth and gives one small nod.
@Vy looks down at her own hobbled knees in the tight silk with her mouth closed, while @Thu stands still and silent.
clips.sfx: a fluorescent tube buzzing and flickering, a kitchen door swinging on its hinge, ragged sobbing breath, a distant siren

wardrobe.@Vy: a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, a matching red khăn vấn headband, a thin gold necklace, beige high heels

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Giờ mình phải làm sao hả anh? Cửa trước, cửa sau đều có người canh rồi.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Giơ tay lên. Lừa hai lão trót lọt, đến lão thứ ba lại trắng tay vì một người cầm thước dây.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Thôi anh. Tại em đặt áo cưới nhầm tiệm.

steps: @Vy stands facing the frosted glass exit door, blue and red light pulsing over her smudged red lipstick, and is already asking a small lost question without looking away.
@Vy keeps speaking in a small voice, her eyes glistening in the pulsing light.
@Vy keeps talking, glancing at the dark corridor behind her and back at the glass.
@Vy goes on, her voice thinning to almost nothing.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, and @Khai sets the black leather document folder down on the concrete and starts answering in a low bitter voice.
@Khai slowly raises both open hands to shoulder height, still talking, with a dry half-laugh.
@Khai keeps speaking bitterly, his raised palms bathed in blue and red light.
@Khai keeps talking, a crooked half-smile under his thin moustache.
@Khai goes on with a dry laugh, shaking his head slowly at the glass.
@Khai keeps speaking to the last words, his eyes half-closed.
@Khai closes his mouth, and @Vy slowly raises her trembling hands too, the red silk sleeves sliding down her wrists, and starts murmuring in a broken voice.
@Vy keeps murmuring, her eyes on the floor, while @Khai stands with his hands raised and his mouth closed.
@Vy keeps speaking in a hollow whisper to the end of the line.
@Vy finishes the last word, closes her mouth and lowers her eyes.
Both stand with open raised hands and mouths closed as the blue and red light floods over their faces and the gold phoenix on her silk.
clips.sfx: a siren winding down just outside, the crackle of a distant radio, fluorescent hum, one shaky breath

title: Cây Tùng Đổ
location: Sảnh tiệc khách sạn lúc khuya khi khách đã về hết: đèn chùm tắt bớt, ghế ngổn ngang, cánh hoa hồng rơi đầy thảm.
axis: Máy quay đặt trên mép sân khấu nhìn xuống sảnh: cổng hoa rũ sau lưng máy, các bàn tròn bỏ dở ở giữa, chiếc ghế Tùng ngồi giữa sảnh, cửa lớn ở xa nhất.
props: Ghế tiệc ngổn ngang, cánh hoa hồng đỏ rơi đầy thảm, cổng hoa rũ, đèn chùm chỉ còn một ngọn sáng, nến cháy dở, điện thoại màn hình trống của Tùng, gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
setting: A lavish hotel banquet hall set for an engagement ceremony in the evening: round tables with white cloths and red roses, a low stage with a flower arch and a gold heart backdrop with no letters, trays of betrothal gifts covered in red cloth, crystal chandeliers, warm golden light.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Vâng, tôi nghe đây. Tài khoản bị phong toả rồi ạ? Năm tỷ trả về công ty... Vâng, công ty của vợ tôi. Hai người ấy khai cả rồi à? Không, tôi chưa về đâu, về cũng chẳng còn ai đợi. Tôi ngồi đây thêm một lúc. Cảm ơn anh.
clips.tone: flat and hollow, drained of everything

shots.camera: 50mm medium tracking shot of the man trudging into the middle of the deserted hall with a phone at his ear
85mm close-up of his face as he sinks onto a banquet chair, locked off

steps: @Tung trudges into the middle of the empty banquet hall, a phone with a glowing blank screen pressed to his ear, and is already speaking in a flat hollow voice, his suit jacket crumpled.
@Tung keeps talking into the phone in short tired phrases, stepping over scattered rose petals.
@Tung stops walking and keeps speaking, his free hand rubbing his forehead.
@Tung keeps talking into the phone, eyes half-closed, his face grey in the low light.
@Tung sinks onto a banquet chair, still speaking flatly into the phone.
@Tung keeps speaking, his free hand hanging between his knees.
@Tung keeps talking, a bitter little breath escaping between phrases.
@Tung keeps speaking quietly, nodding at nothing.
@Tung keeps talking, slumped on the chair among the abandoned round tables, one chandelier glowing low above him.
@Tung goes on in a dull murmur, staring at the drooping flower arch on the stage.
@Tung keeps speaking, his voice dropping lower.
@Tung keeps murmuring into the phone, his eyes wet.
@Tung says the last tired words, closes his mouth and lowers the phone from his ear.
@Tung's hand lays the phone with its glowing blank screen on his knee, rose petals scattered on the carpet below.
A single rose petal drifts down and settles beside @Tung's polished black shoe.
clips.sfx: the hum of a nearly empty hall, a phone call clicking off, a chair creaking, rose petals settling

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Mẹ đặt tên con là Tùng, mong con cứng như cây tùng, gió mấy cũng đứng.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Mẹ ra đây để mắng con nốt đấy à? Mắng đi, con chịu hết mà.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Mắng gì nữa. Một tà váy đỏ lướt qua là cây tùng nhà mẹ đổ rạp.

85mm close-up of the son lifting his wet face, locked off
40mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the seated son up to the old mother, locked off
50mm medium two-shot of mother and son under the single chandelier, locked off

steps: @BaNhan stands beside @Tung's chair, leaning on her carved bamboo walking stick, and is already speaking slowly and heavily down to him, while @Tung sits slumped with his mouth closed.
@BaNhan keeps speaking in a heavy sorrowful voice, her eyes on the top of her son's head.
@BaNhan keeps talking slowly, both thin hands folded on the head of her stick.
@BaNhan goes on, her gaze lifting to the drooping flower arch on the stage.
@BaNhan keeps speaking toward the last words, her voice catching slightly.
@BaNhan closes her mouth, and @Tung lifts his wet face and starts asking a bitter question, eyes red-rimmed.
@Tung keeps speaking bitterly, his voice cracking, his hands limp on his knees.
@Tung keeps talking, a wet half-laugh escaping him.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, staring up at her.
